$description: Dark Luminous Workbench semantic aliases that extend the vendored brand exchange (surface ladder, secondary/muted text, quiet/strong lines, accent light-fallback -text roles). Single dark theme — light-surface variants are forced-colours/high-contrast fallbacks only (BRAND-RECONCILIATION.md §5-D).

inset.$description: Inset one step up from raised (was compat --color-surface-3).

on-accent.$description: Ink on a luminous accent fill.

border.$description: Structural edge — a panel, a card, a field. Was line.quiet, renamed 2026-09-20 (Ben) so that the pair border/divider says which is which; 'quiet' did not, and the whole rule is that a divider is quieter than a border.

divider.$description: Between items within one list, and nothing else. Never above the first item or below the last, and never between sections — space does that (patterns/separation.md). Pure white rather than the paper tint: at 10% the tint is not perceptible, and an untinted separator composes predictably over any surface, including a card image.
